Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences builds AI systems that accelerate discovery across the physical and life sciences. Within Physical Sciences AI, we work with experimental teams to build autonomous discovery agents that decide which experiments Lila's AI Science Factories should run next.

Real scientific campaigns rarely look like textbook optimization problems. A single campaign can mix large discrete choices (which components, which recipe) with continuous settings (amounts, temperatures, times), pursue several objectives under hard constraints, and draw on evidence from literature and characterization data. Every experiment costs real time and materials. Off-the-shelf methods often struggle here, and they ignore the domain structure that could guide the search.

As a Bayesian Methods Co-Op, you will work alongside research scientists and engineers on a focused project within one broad question: how AI systems can make better experimental decisions. Depending on your background, that could mean building agents that choose the next experiment, testing when in-context learners can be trusted as decision-makers, or developing Bayesian strategies for tight experimental budgets. Your methods will be tested against live campaigns.

What You'll Be Building

  • Design and benchmark experiment-selection strategies that balance exploration and exploitation under realistic budgets

jobs.title: Co-Op, Reaction Prediction & Benchmarking
jobs.location_raw: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Develop and evaluate machine learning methods supporting small molecule design and synthesis. Working with public and internal chemistry datasets, the co-op will pursue a focused research project in either reaction prediction and benchmarking or molecular property prediction for medicinal chemistry optimization.

Potential projects include building benchmarks to assess reaction prediction models and reaction plausibility, or developing and fine-tuning molecular property predictors using project-specific data. The primary project will be selected based on the candidate’s interests, experience, and team priorities. Expected outputs include reproducible data and evaluation workflows, benchmark results, and research recommendations to inform future model development and integration.

What You'll Be Building

  • Plan and execute a Co-Op project in conjunction with the Molecular Intelligence team

What You'll Need to Succeed

jobs.title: Co-Op, Robot Perception & State Estimation
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

As a Co-Op on the Production Robotics team at Lila Sciences, you will help build the algorithms and software that let our robots know where they are and what they are looking at, so they can run scientific workflows reliably inside the AI Science Factories (AISFs). The team develops the state estimation, perception, and testing infrastructure that general-purpose robotic skills depend on.

Your work will sit at the intersection of estimation, computer vision, and robotics software. You will help improve how our mobile bases estimate their position and motion, develop camera-based detection and localization of AprilTags and lab instruments, and strengthen the simulation-based testing and CI that validate changes before they reach hardware. Expect a mix of writing production-quality software, applying math to real sensor data, and debugging real-world behavior on physical robots.

You will work alongside robotics engineers, AI researchers, and software engineers, with day-to-day support from the Production Robotics team. The output is software that runs in production lab environments and directly accelerates the rate at which Lila can run experiments.

What You'll Be Building

  • Fuse multi-sensor data to improve mobile base state estimation
  • Build camera-based AprilTag and instrument detection and localization for robot manipulation and navigation
  • Develop new robot capab

jobs.title: Co-Op, Targeted Non-Viral Delivery
jobs.description_text:

Lila is seeking a co-op to help build the automated non-viral delivery platform. The role focuses on improving an automated system for production and characterization of targeted lipid nanoparticles (tLNP).

Day-to-day work involves producing tLNPs to support ongoing experiments, developing new conjugation and purification methods for tLNPs, and applying those methods on the automated system.

The co-op works alongside chemists, biologists, automation engineers, and data scientists, with hands-on time across both bench science and automated lab systems.

What You'll Be Building

  • Formulate and characterize targeted LNPs on an automated microfluidic workcell
  • Run high-throughput screens of ionizable lipids and targeting ligands
  • Execute downstream characterization assays such as DLS, RiboGreen, and TNS
  • Onboard new workflows and experiment types onto the workcell
  • Test and document changes that increase screening throughput
  • Record methods, results, and observations in the ELN for reuse across teams

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Hands-on wet-lab experience and comfort following detailed SOPs
  • Data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret results and iterate on

About MSF USA | Doctors Without Borders

 

Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an independent international organization that provides medical care to the people who need it most. The organization cares for people affected by conflict, disease outbreaks, disasters, and social exclusion in more than 70 countries. MSF offers medical humanitarian assistance solely based on need, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, or politics. Our international project teams include medical, logistical, and administrative staff, most of them hired locally and working with their own communities. Our actions are guided by medical ethics and the principles of independence, impartiality, and neutrality. We also bear witness and speak out about the experiences of our colleagues and patients.

jobs.description_text:
About the role

Muon Space seeks a Industrial Security Specialist / Assistant Facility Security Officer (AFSO) to join our Security team, reporting to the Senior Security Manager. The ideal candidate is a hands-on individual contributor who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and brings deep technical expertise across the full spectrum of industrial security disciplines. This person will execute day-to-day security operations in support of DoD and IC programs, serve as a subject matter expert for personnel, physical, and program security, and partner closely with program teams to ensure compliance with 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) and applicable Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs). This person will play a key role in maintaining our facility clearance, protecting classified programs, and enabling Muon's mission to deliver Earth Intelligence for a safer, more resilient world.

This position is fully onsite and requires working in our Mountain View, CA office five days a week.

Responsibilities

  • Execute day-to-day Assistant Facility Security Officer (AFSO) duties in support of our DoD Facility Clearance, including personnel security actions, visit requests, and interfacing with DCSA and USG customers.
  • Administer the personnel security program — process clearance actions in DISS, conduct initial and refresher security briefings/debriefings, and maintain accurate personnel

jobs.title: International Business Development Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text:
About the role

Summer internships will range between the months of May and September depending on university schedules. Internship is full-time and on-site in Washington, DC.

The Growth team at Muon is responsible for expanding Muon’s customer base to international defence and civil agencies with satellite constellations. Interns can look forward to owning a project from start to finish which could involve conducting market research, competitive analysis, budget research, recommending potential in-country partnerships for a specified country, and mapping out customer engagement with key in-country leadership.  Come work with the team and help us expand into the international market!

Muon is a small and fast growing startup which offers interns the experience to get direct mentorship and have real impact on our programs. As an intern, you'll collaborate with a dynamic team in a startup environment and have the chance to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the industry. We're committed to offering an experience where your decisions and contributions play a pivotal role in driving Muon's success.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of or contribute to the market research needed to identify key opportunities that are matched with Muon’s capabilities.
  • Initiate or assist competitive analysis and assessment of in-country primes, or other external satellite bus manufacturers.

jobs.description_text:
About the role

Muon seeks an IT Manager to join our Information Technology team. The ideal candidate is a proactive IT leader with a strong background in enterprise software evaluation, SaaS lifecycle management, and vendor integration. In this role, you will lead IT operations and our tooling landscape—driving trade studies, software selection, and day-to-day administration—so our teams have the secure, high-impact tools they need to execute efficiently. Information Systems owns the software, data platforms, and automated tools that help our teams move faster, our factories build efficiently, and our launch teams operate flawlessly.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Trade Studies & SaaS Selection: Lead technical trade studies and software evaluations with stakeholders to select SaaS solutions that fit architecturally, securely, and cost-effectively.
  • Procurement Support: Partner with Legal, InfoSec, and Procurement on technical due diligence, vendor onboarding, and SLA reviews.
  • Tool Setup & Deployment: Work with IT and business owners on tenant configuration and integration of newly acquired software.
  • License Lifecycle & Cost: Manage licenses, forecast renewal budgets, allocate costs by team, and track seat utilization and license harvesting to eliminate waste.
